clips.title: The story
paras: A caravan shipment bound for Rezlak lies scattered among the harpy roosts of Razorwind Canyon. Dustwind harpies intercepted the goods as they crossed Durotar.

Rezlak needs steady supplies for his work outside Orgrimmar. The goblin engineer, contracted from Ratchet by Gazlowe, builds for the Horde. A caravan carrying a promised shipment passed near the canyon road south of Orgrimmar, where Dustwind harpies ambushed it. They dragged the cargo into their roosts in Razorwind Canyon, scattering sacks among dirt and scree beside their nesting sites.
